title: The gate
hints: You need to move to the right to stand in front of the gate.
The lesson's first instruction is the one that moves your wizard to the right.
Look back at the lesson's example: it takes exactly one step, and that is all you need.
intro: We need to get to the spot right in front of the great gate. Let us walk there and see if it opens!
outro: Great! You've learned to move your wizard. Now let's see how we get through this gate.
learned: Now you know what a program and an instruction are, and the instruction that moves your wizard.
